executive_summary:
The host continues her theory that Charlie Kirk's microphone was rigged. She first addresses the St. Michael necklace, playing clips in which a speaker who appears to be Frank Turek and Andrew Kolvet describe it (A-2677). She rejects the idea that the necklace itself was rigged, but argues that, if her theory is right, it would have carried explosive residue, which she says would explain why police looked for it and why it was handed to Erika Kirk. She recaps the oddities she says the theory explains (A-2678.1), cites an article on PETN's high soil absorption (A-2678.2), and plays paver Dan Merrill telling Jimmy Rex that about 10 inches of soil had already been dug out before he arrived (A-2679.1).

The host then turns to the wireless mic. According to the host, audio professionals emailed her (A-2682.1) to say that placing a Rode Wireless Pro inside a shirt makes no sense. She shows fall 2024 tour footage in which the mic moves from outside to inside Charlie Kirk's shirt from October 8 (A-2680.2). Using X user Sam Parker's video (A-2683.1), she identifies Philip Goldsberry Jr., on Terrell Farnsworth's team, as the technician who fitted the mic under Charlie's shirt next to the necklace. She says Goldsberry's father, Dr. Philip Goldsberry, an Arizona pastor, co-founded Soter Global Ministries in 2006. According to its website (A-2684), the group worked with orphanages in Romania, Ukraine and Albania and visited a shelter for human trafficking victims. She adds Goldsberry to her "connecting themes" spreadsheet of Eastern European links around Turning Point USA (A-2685.1). The spreadsheet covers Erika Kirk's Romanian Angels Project, Tyler Bowyer's time in Romania and Russia, Rob McCoy's adoption from Russia, Greg Laurie's Harvest church lawsuits, a Kolvet brother stationed in Romania, and donor Nelda Buckman.

The host recounts her post-assassination call with Terrell Farnsworth (A-2681.1). She says he told her the event was live-streamed to "the ops back in Phoenix," not to TPUSA headquarters. She asks why Charlie Kirk's handheld mic, phone and necklace went to TPUSA or Erika Kirk rather than into evidence, and where his white Freedom shirt is. She sets clips of Frank Turek and Rob McCoy saying CPR was given in the car against Brian Harpole saying it was not (A-2686). She also says she believes the assassination is linked to the Jeffrey Epstein network, stating that this is her opinion.

After a light segment on a post about Erika Kirk's signature (A-2687), the comments segment covers the "paver emergency," the White House Correspondents' Dinner "emotional asset" email (A-2689.1), and a Decentralized Intelligence Agency beat. In that beat the host says her $10,000 bounty has still not identified who recorded the Erika Kirk exit video (A-2690.1). She also says Brian Harpole's filing asserts a 911 call she cannot find in the released recordings, and that Trump was the one who called Erika Kirk on September 10.

claims.label: Terrell Farnsworth removed the back camera and recorded a selfie video minutes after the shooting
claims.claim: The host says Terrell Farnsworth raced to take down the camera behind Charlie Kirk's head minutes after he died, and recorded a selfie video of himself declaring that Charlie was dead seconds after he died.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU and police video of the stage area after the shooting, and Farnsworth's selfie video with its file metadata, to fix when the camera was removed and when the video was recorded.

claims.label: Clip: Charlie Kirk's necklace was found draped over a bag in the car, and police had been looking for it
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, a speaker (apparently Frank Turek) says that when he got back into the car he found Charlie Kirk's cross-and-medallion necklace draped over his bag, that a police officer said they had been looking for it, and that he took it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source interview for the clip, and request police evidence logs showing whether the necklace was sought, logged or released.
claims.transcript_snippet: I got into the car and I pulled out my bag and draped over my bag was Charlie's necklace that had a cross and medallions on it. And I had heard they were looking for that.

claims.label: Clip: Andrew Kolvet says the necklace was ripped off during life-saving efforts and Erika Kirk now wears it
claims.claim: In a clip the host later attributes to Andrew Kolvet on Laura Ingraham's show, Kolvet says Erika Kirk gave Charlie Kirk the necklace when they were dating, that the people caring for him ripped it off as they tried to save his life, and that Erika Kirk now has it on her at all times.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full broadcast of the Kolvet interview and compare it with the transport-vehicle accounts of who removed the necklace and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: the people caring for him ripped it off as they tried to save his life and um uh Erika has it on her all times now.

claims.label: Host theorizes the necklace was sought and returned to the widow because it would carry explosive residue
claims.claim: The host rejects the theory that the necklace itself was rigged. Under her rigged-microphone theory, she argues that federal agents looked for the necklace and it was given to Erika Kirk because, worn on Charlie Kirk's chest, it would have carried explosive residue.
claims.investigative_direction: Request chain-of-custody records for the necklace and any forensic testing of it before release to the family.
claims.transcript_snippet: the reason the feds were looking for that necklace, the reason um that it was given to Erika is because if our theory is correct, it contained explosive residue.

claims.label: Host says the rigged-mic theory would explain why bomb dogs were kept away and the scene was paved over
claims.claim: Presenting a recap graphic, the host says that if Charlie Kirk's microphone was rigged, it would explain why bomb dogs were kept away from the scene and why the crime scene was immediately paved over and its soil excavated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain police and federal K-9 deployment records for the UVU scene on September 10 and the work orders for the paving and excavation.
claims.transcript_snippet: The rigged mic would go a long way in terms of explaining uh why the bomb dogs were kept away from the scene.

claims.label: Article: PETN's low water solubility and high soil absorption would require digging out the soil
claims.claim: Citing a science article she shows, the host says PETN has low water solubility and high soil absorption, so that if PETN was the explosive, the soil would have to be dug out.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the cited article and check its PETN soil-sorption data against the environmental chemistry literature.
claims.transcript_snippet: it says that the low water solubility and high soil absorption, um, of PETN in particular, if we think that is the explosive, it would be very problematic and you would, in fact, need to dig out the soil.

claims.label: Paver Dan Merrill says a government team dug out 8 to 10 inches of soil before he arrived
claims.claim: The host says paver Dan Merrill, in his interview with Jimmy Rex, described his crew as the second team on site that Sunday. According to Merrill, another government team had already been sent to dig out 8 to 10 inches of soil.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU facilities and contractor records for the excavation and paving, including which agency or contractor removed the soil and where it was taken.
claims.transcript_snippet: just a few days later, they had sent another government team to go in and to dig out all of the soil. 8 to 10 in of soil.

claims.label: Clip: about 10 inches of dirt had been excavated around the scene
claims.claim: In the Jimmy Rex interview clip, Dan Merrill says that when he arrived and photographed the site, about 10 inches of dirt had been taken out around the whole area.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Merrill's photographs with metadata and compare them with UVU's records of the site work.
claims.transcript_snippet: When I showed up, I took pictures of what it looked like. They had taken out about 10 in of the dirt around the whole place.

claims.transcript_snippet: Why there appears to be shattered black plastic or glass all over the SUV which transported Charlie to the hospital.
